convert_ldm_checkpoint: convert an LDM checkpoint state dict to a diffusers-compatible checkpoint using the provided config
run_checkpoint_conversion_cli: run the CLI script to convert an LDM checkpoint to a diffusers UNet2DModel using checkpoint path, config file, and dump path
renew_resnet_paths: update ResNet layer paths from the old LDM naming scheme to the new diffusers naming scheme
renew_attention_paths: update attention layer paths from the old LDM naming scheme to the new diffusers naming scheme
assign_to_checkpoint: assign converted weights to a new checkpoint with global renaming and attention layer splitting
